name: (04) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 2 Intermediate — Fear-Plague

system.description:
Drawing a victim's deepest fears from their mind and hurling them back, the infernalist leaves the subject hounded at every turn, denied any peace of mind.

Spend a Willpower Trait and defeat your target in a Mental Challenge. On a win they cannot spend Willpower Traits for any purpose that does not directly complement their Nature or immediately serve their survival as they perceive it. The effect lasts one week; your victim must be within your line of sight when you activate it, though it then persists wherever they go. Retest with Intimidation.
